question: What dual cosmic roles are attributed to the life-abiding principle of all beings?
premises: It abides in the life of all beings.
It is called the lord of rivers.
inference: The life-abiding principle is both the source of beings and the lord of rivers.
uncertainties: Whether yoniḥ and patiḥ refer to the same subject or to two aspects is context-dependent.
plain_english: Abiding in the life of all beings, it is the womb and the lord of rivers.
